summaries.Good news: Real breakthroughs are happening: an arthritis drug is restoring hair in alopecia patients, Ford's factory now sports a living roof supporting birds and energy savings, and communities are restoring vital ecosystems from the Thames to Jordan's rangelands.
summaries.Ideas: AI's transformative moment is here—from solving century-old math problems to raising serious safety concerns among researchers publicly resigning, while Apple positions its devices as AI-first platforms that promise to balance capability with privacy.
summaries.Technology: Apple's iPhone Duo foldable marks a major redesign moment, battery records are being shattered, and unexpected breakthroughs (from cyborg cockroach paramedics to smart telescopes fighting star trails) hint at innovation across every layer of consumer tech.
summaries.Design: Tactile and multisensory experiences are redefining interiors and products—from sound-absorbing wallpapers to modular seating and reimagined classics—while emerging galleries and young studios are injecting fresh energy into design culture.
